title.zh: 延长第588号共和国法的有效期，为此进一步修订其第8条（题为“修订第466号联邦法（即国家国内税收法典）若干条款”）
title.en: An Act to Extend the Effectivity of Republic Act Numbered Five Hundred and Eighty-eight, By Further Amending Section Eight Thereof, Entitled "An Act to Amend Certain Sections of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred and Sixty-six, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code."
title.orig: An Act to Extend the Effectivity of Republic Act Numbered Five Hundred and Eighty-eight, By Further Amending Section Eight Thereof, Entitled "An Act to Amend Certain Sections of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred and Sixty-six, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code."

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_958_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 8 条，缺 3、4、5、6、7）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。

text.en:
Section eight of Republic Act Numbered Five hundred and eighty-eight, as amended by Republic Act Numbered Seven hundred and twenty-six, is further amended to read as follows:
"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval, but unless otherwise expressly extended by Congress, the increased taxes provided for in this Act shall continue in force and effect only until December thirty-one, nineteen hundred and fifty-four, after which period the original rates of tax shall again be in force."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
